svg.title: connetto-rs architecture
svg.desc: Architecture diagram: components, library seams, and data flows, colored by build status. Redrawn per plans/architecture-diagram-refresh.md.

g.text: source of truth, one instance today
mesh: open question X7, reframed as R73 failover verification
the hard parts are existing Postgres features, the phase is verification and a deployment recipe
change-path visibility executor: batched checks, fail closed
tracing events from every crate, libraries install no subscriber
programs install: JSON to stdout (native), console (browser)
any subscriber installable, aggregation is an ops choice outside connetto
in this repo, beside connetto-server on the same deployment: chunk storage, upload, serving, collection
chunks in a filesystem directory or an object store, never in Postgres
reached over HTTP under a ticket connetto-server mints, metadata stays ordinary synced rows
two-phase upload: intent, needed hashes, chunk PUTs, commit
ranged GET with a strong ETag, immutable caching, 404 for absent or forbidden
mark and sweep from the chunk registry, grace equal to the ticket lifetime
seam: ContentTicketSigner, the one trait connetto-core gained
storage quotas and deployment ceilings, 507 quota and 503 ceilings with Retry-After, R87
in this repo, the library the file server and both file clients share, tested under wasm too
identity is blake3 of the bytes, computed in the chunking pass
FastCDC per mime class, zstd then XChaCha20-Poly1305
the chunk's plaintext hash is the store key and the AEAD aad
seam: ChunkStore (write, read, has, delete) by content hash
seam: ChunkInventory, for the stores that can list what they hold
a manifest is the ordered (hash, length) list, transport metadata only
the same bytes chunk and hash identically on native and wasm
in this repo: sessions, materializer, RLS writes
grants resolve to a Principal, session registry
resume tokens, revocation closes live connections
mint with write-level shares, key subjects
caller binding first in every RLS transaction
reserved pool share, snapshot page cap, per-tier read time bound
auth_events contract, every producer emits its op
high-volume stream goes to the structured log
durable reconnect log, startup refuses a missing slot
retained WAL and headroom logged on a cadence
crates.io: PatchSet binary format (no SQLite needed)
seam: connetto asks only through the visibility trait
WHERE compile, dedup, VM eval, notifications
Accumulator state (IVM), folded per CDC event
COUNT, SUM, AVG, VAR, STDDEV, scalar MIN and MAX
grouped GROUP BY / HAVING folds, keyed per group
over the group budget: demoted to whole re-reads
MIN, MAX, joins, row shapes via the server's connector
per-viewer runs on RLS tables: each viewer's own answer
a failing read ends its subscription, not live delivery: R89
RowPolicy, OpenFgaPolicy, one shared Shapes index
our fork, pinned: WAL streaming, pgoutput decode
PG DDL to SQLite DDL plus translation manifest
also runs client-side at build time
RLS policy text to an FGA model, per-row records
identity provider: login and token issuance
OIDC token verification on every session
each grant resolves into a Principal
a developer registers an app: its public key and the tables it wants
a user installs it on their own data, three synced tables under RLS
one route: a signed assertion buys an ordinary login grant
the bot is a user of the deployment, no browser and no password
connetto-client, in this repo, built and verified
LiveRows<R> + grouped typed live() + generic hooks delivered
our fork, pinned, near upstream parity
seam: SQLite hooks, limits, changeset surface
PatchSet apply and generate via diesel
resting table for server results: offline restart shows the last synced value
SQLCipher, per-replica key, OS keyring custody
local (never-syncing) tier attached, inherits the replica key
R21: one page codec on both targets
unlock gate built in the browser. Native gates R51 and R52 wait for the mobile demo build R88, R53 blocked on hardware
Linux keyring custody across a reboot: R71
pg2sqlite translates PG DDL to replica DDL plus translation manifest
translation emits fail-closed write guards, server applies land exempt (connetto_write_exempt)
the client is refused without the manifest
auth code + PKCE, token store, refresh
evicts uncovered rows, runs by itself on a row threshold
zipped change records and unsent content, one entry at a time
import restores device tier and unsent writes, same account
Several accounts signed in at once
built: a switch replaces the DB worker, own account index
in this repo: the store, the outbox, the resolver, the pins
manifests, outbox and pins in the replica, committed with the row
encrypted store on std::fs, bytes over HTTP under one ticket
outbox walk with a boot pass, a server refusal stays queued
resolver: a signed URL by default, local bytes when unsent or pinned
built: the demos drive the content surface end to end, R69
R74 to R80 (design concluded as R25, chapter 19)
two devices exchange signed writes over the LAN with no server
mTLS with device certificates, the server still adjudicates later
a lost device's signed queue is recovered through a courier
one dedup domain, the (device key, sequence) frontier
BLE beacon bootstrap later, phones need R88 first
connetto-web, in this repo, built and browser-verified
auth code + PKCE, token store, refresh
runs over a Transport to the DB worker
own memory-VFS mirror, typed live() local
leader tab owns it: OPFS replica, server connection, relay hub
one socket in the worker, tabs relay through it
our library, git, same as native
sqlite3mc over OPFS, SQLCipher v4 file format, per-replica key
IndexedDB custody, KEK wraps per-identity replica keys, refresh rides an HttpOnly cookie
R21: one page codec on both targets
unlock gate built: passkey-derived key (WebAuthn PRF), enrolment re-wraps custody
evicts and trims the OPFS replica, same threshold
Several accounts signed in at once
built: the worker asks the tab which account after the gate
the same archive through the DB worker, a Blob in and out, same account only
the same crate on a worker-owned encrypted OPFS store, same outbox, resolver and pins, R68

svg.text: same file format both sides: PRAGMA cipher 'sqlcipher', legacy 4 (R21 removes the pin)

g.text: connetto-client with no screen, R91 (chapter 13, template examples/bot-template)
a program holds a query, is told when it changed, and writes values back through the same client as a screen
it logs in with a key it holds, as the app's bot user, and keeps that session across restarts
it sees only the rows its installers shared with it, either one user at a time or all together
its traffic is charged to the user it acts for, or to the developer's app allowance, never to the bot
its replica lives in memory, a durable one is R93, after R71's Linux key custody
Seam defects: one document per finding in upstream/.
Phase status: plans/master-implementation-plan.md, Status and Sequence tables.
